reviews.text: The apartment is quite swanky. It’s a quiet type of luxury and central location, easy to catch public transport (taxi/bus) from and 15-30 mins walking to the local shops/restaurants. The premises is secure with gated security, whom are incredibly friendly once you become familiar. Because there’s lots of exposure to the sun, the space gets excellent natural lighting, and the air conditioning system keeps the room at a comfortable temperature. I originally made the reservation because I flew to Türkiye because of a family medical emergency, and I was able to book and check in the same day arriving at the airport. My handicapped relative was able to access the building easily after being discharged from the hospital. Would recommend for small groups or families (3-4 people).
Rezidans konumu sapa, temizlik orta. Ev kullanışlı.
Great host, very responsive place was very safe and modern.
Spacious and lots of natural light. friendly host who was there to greet us at the entrance.
